name: implemented-by-migration
body:
A durable spec must be readable by the binary that is RUNNING it — the parent. A change-set must not make the parent depend on its future child. Language-rooted FQNs (`rust.apg.cmd_scan`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.runCli`, `java.CallGraphBuilder.main`, …) are a child-era rendering: they exist only once the rooting change-set's binary scans the tree. Storing rooted FQNs in the durable spec therefore made the parent grade every authored `implemented-by` target DRIFT as soon as the change-set's transient planned-node bridge died — the plan store is transient, the node files are durable, so the durable spec outlived the bridge that had made the rooted targets valid.

The corrected design keeps authored `implemented-by` targets LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC: each target is stored as the bare code identity (`apg.cmd_scan`, `CallGraphBuilder.main`, `apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.runCli`), exactly the identity a pre-rooting scan renders. The ingestor resolves an authored target LANGUAGE-ROOT TOLERANTLY — exact match first, then `<language-root>.<target>` for every root (`rust`/`java`/`go`/`cpp`/`csharp`/`ts`/`js`/`py`/`md`), with a leading `<root>.` stripped from a scanned side where needed (see `apg.layers.classify_code_ref` / `resolves_in_scanned`, `src/layers.rs`). The same authored target therefore resolves under BOTH the pre-rooting parent (bare scanned universe) and the rooted child (rooted scanned universe).

Consequences: no migration, no planned-node bridge, and no drift. Authored targets never carry a language root; the earlier bare→rooted re-point of every `implemented-by` target (and its planned-node bridge) is RETIRED — the durable spec is parent-compatible exactly as authored, and a change to the scanned universe's rendering (rooted or not) cannot invalidate it. This is a durable-spec correctness rule, not net-new code: it constrains how targets are STORED, not what the scanner renders.

Acceptance: after ANY scan (rooted or not) every authored `implemented-by` target resolves against the scanned code universe — no DRIFT on the next scan/validate; no authored `implemented-by` target carries a language root; the spine query reaches the implementing code under either rendering; the parent binary can scan the merged tree without drift; each authored edge has both halves present (node-file pairing consistent); `apg plan verify` does not refuse for a missing/drifted implementation target.
